title: Drift-index circuit breaker for recursive self-improvement
description: Monitor a drift index computed from public outputs during self-training, and reject any candidate version whose index exceeds a threshold, continuing from the last trusted version. Prediction: lower held-out spec drift than a tuned cycle cap, with no loss of completion beyond the margin.

source.title: SAHOO: Safeguarded Alignment for High-Order Optimization Objectives in Recursive Self-Improvement
source.venue: ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement

untestable_reason: Needs a system that retrains on its own outputs across cycles, with a planted spec to measure drift against and a controller that can keep or reject each version. No current testbed has a system that changes itself over cycles. testbeds/recursive_drift is designed for this case and is under review.

preregistration.onset_definition: first cycle with held-out compliance 10% below v0 under always-accept
